description: Maximum Electricity Demand by Sector (MW) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents the maximum annual electricity demand measured in megawatts (MW) across key sectors in Qatar. It includes total system demand along with sector-specific peaks for industrial and domestic use. The data can inform infrastructure planning, energy policy development, and load forecasting across different economic sectors. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, demand, peak, sector, domestic. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
